messages.author: 1117aec6ea33f752
messages.subject: Re: can shiny be used to build a dynamic webpage
parts:
shiny server open source does not support multiple users at the same time (per app), which means that when one user's session runs a query or some calculation, other users will not be able to perform any actions in the app.
you can solve it by either providing your users with local versions of the shiny app (to run using rstudio/docker), or by duplicating the app on the server - one copy per team/user. the open-source shiny server supports multiple apps (processes) running at the same time.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: can shiny be used to build a dynamic webpage
parts: What Shiny Server Open Source doesn't support is multiple *R processes* per app, but each R process can support multiple simultaneous users. It does mean that calculations cannot be performed concurrently though, so all the requests are serialized. For 50 concurrent users, it really depends on how latent your database is and how often each user is reading/writing. In the future you will also be able to use Shiny's upcoming async functionality (though this will be rightfully considered pretty advanced).
